correctness.rationale: Skolem–Bang r/alpha^i+s/alpha^(i+d)=1 converts disjointness to positive integral coefficients. Alpha²=2alpha+4 and alpha^n=2^(n-1)F_n alpha+2^n F_(n-1) force r=2^i F_(i+d)/F_d and s=(-1)^(d-1)2^(i+d)F_i/F_d. Even d cannot give positive s; for odd d, F_d has 2-adic valuation at most one and integrality reduces to odd(F_d)|F_i. Strong gcd(F_d,F_i)=F_g, Fibonacci growth and g<=d/3 when proper odd divisor exclude all d>=5 unless d|i. F_3=2 gives the exceptional d=3. Independently tested 5000 odd (i,d) pairs against exact integer Fibonacci residues.
